Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was stopped in the right lane of the roadway in Baytown, Texas, waiting for traffic ahead to clear, when
Driver 2 approached from behind and failed to stop in time, striking the rear of Driver 1's vehicle. A Passenger was
seated in the frnot passenger seat of Driver 1's vehicle at the time of impact. Driver 2 stated that the collision occurred
just as described by Driver 1, and two independent witnesses at the scene gave consistent accounts. Photographs
taken at the scene show damage to the rear bumper and trunk area of Driver 1's vehicle that is consistent with the
force of a rear impact of this type. Driver 1 reported pain in the lower back immediately after the crash, and the nature
and force of the collision are consistent with that complaint. Officers confirmed through witness statements and
on-scene observation that Driver 1 was in the vehicle when the collision occurred. Officers found no indication of prior
damage to the vehicle in the same area. Driver 1 is listed as a named driver on the insurance policy covering the
vehicle. Driver 1 was transported for evaluation and the report is submitted for review.
